provenance: Derived from the checked-in 32,400-entry client prefill vector and source-FSM/address mapping; not captured physical read events.

vector.request_semantics: aligned logical canonical 16-byte client line misses in CHECK_ROWS chroma-prefill then raster-luma order

assumptions.controller_mode: CAS3, BL8, x16, address in 16-bit words
assumptions.controller_start: IDLE after initialization; open rows initially closed
assumptions.startup_phase: idealized accounting phase with refresh_count=0; not the literal post-MRS controller count
assumptions.request_offer: next request continuously valid whenever source controller is IDLE

frames.actual_001: byte-exact fixture verified in upstream verify_models.py
frames.actual_006: byte-exact fixture verified in upstream verify_models.py

raster_control.scope: serialized always-ready read-only source-state replay; initial power-up/init excluded

tile_independent.scope: serialized always-ready read-only source-state replay; initial power-up/init excluded

tile_retained.scope: serialized always-ready read-only source-state replay; initial power-up/init excluded

interpretation.command_counts: Exact for this serialized event replay of the read-side FSM and these generated physical bursts.
interpretation.timing: State waits and BL8 response beats follow moonshine_sdram.sv; excludes initial 20,000-cycle power-up and two init refreshes.
interpretation.refresh: Every REFRESH_PRE/REFRESH command and all-bank precharge is modeled at the source threshold; threshold counter advances each source cycle.

limits: This is a bounded prefill-work comparison, not an FPS/frame-time or complete-frame estimate.
The raster control assumes canonical raster physical byte placement; the tile scenarios use 8x8 tile-major mapping.
Retained fetch filter mirrors verify_models.cache; upstream verifier checks all 518,400 client bytes for actual_001 and actual_006.
Always-valid serialized source-FSM replay excludes any bridge backpressure, concurrent traffic, arbitration, or board effects.
